verdict.rationale: Activepieces is an open-source Zapier replacement whose flows are built from a trigger plus the actions that run when the flow is activated. It connects 760+ apps, and its agents handle work as it arrives, so event-driven automation is core to the product. Durable execution adds reliability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of conditional rule logic (branching/filters) and of the specific event trigger types (webhooks, polling, schedules), plus independent hands-on corroboration of trigger behavior.
